subcategory_descriptions.ckERC20 Orchestrator: Manages ckERC20 token ledger suites. Creates new ledgers via NNS proposals, handles upgrades, and tops up managed canisters with cycles.
subcategory_descriptions.ckETH Minter: Mints ckETH when users deposit Ether, burns ckETH when processing withdrawal requests. Bridges ETH between Ethereum and ICP.
subcategory_descriptions.ckETH Ledger: Records ckETH token transactions and account balances. Implements ICRC-1/ICRC-2 fungible token standards.
subcategory_descriptions.ckETH Index: Provides transaction history lookups for individual ckETH accounts by periodically pulling from the ledger.
subcategory_descriptions.ckUSDC Ledger: Records ckUSDC stablecoin transactions and balances. ICRC-1/ICRC-2 compliant token ledger.
subcategory_descriptions.ckUSDC Index: Transaction history lookups for ckUSDC accounts.
subcategory_descriptions.ckLINK Ledger: Records ckLINK (Chainlink) token transactions and balances on ICP.
subcategory_descriptions.ckLINK Index: Transaction history lookups for ckLINK accounts.
subcategory_descriptions.ckPEPE Index: Transaction history lookups for ckPEPE memecoin accounts.
subcategory_descriptions.ckOCT Ledger: Records ckOCT token transactions and balances.
subcategory_descriptions.ckUNI Index: Transaction history lookups for ckUNI (Uniswap) token accounts.
subcategory_descriptions.ckEURC Index: Transaction history lookups for ckEURC (Euro stablecoin) accounts.
subcategory_descriptions.ckXAUT Index: Transaction history lookups for ckXAUT (Tether Gold) accounts.

subcategory_descriptions.Core: Main protocol canisters including the FUNNAI token. Handles core PoAIW (Proof-of-AI-Work) functionality and tokenomics.
subcategory_descriptions.Protocol: Protocol layer canisters managing mAIner registries, challenge distribution, scoring, and reward distribution.
subcategory_descriptions.Challenger LLM: Large Language Model that generates challenges/prompts for mAIner agents to respond to in the PoAIW competition.
subcategory_descriptions.Judge LLMs: On-chain LLMs that evaluate and score mAIner responses. Multiple judges provide decentralized, tamper-proof scoring.
subcategory_descriptions.mAIner LLMs: Large Language Models powering the mAIner AI agents. These LLMs generate responses to challenges and compete for rewards.
subcategory_descriptions.DeAI Manifesto: Canisters hosting the DeAI Manifesto, a declaration of principles for decentralized AI development on ICP.
subcategory_descriptions.IConfucius: On-chain AI chatbot using Qwen 2.5 model, themed as Confucius. Generates philosophical quotes and wisdom.
subcategory_descriptions.DeVinci: Browser-based AI chatbot served from ICP. Runs LLM locally in user's browser for privacy-preserving AI conversations.
subcategory_descriptions.ICGPT: On-chain ChatGPT-like application using llama_cpp_canister. Runs LLMs fully on-chain for decentralized AI chat.
subcategory_descriptions.DeAIssemblyline: Factory canisters for creating and deploying autonomous AI agents on the Internet Computer.
subcategory_descriptions.Bitcoin Donation: Canisters handling Bitcoin donations using ICP's native BTC integration.

subcategory_descriptions.SNS Root: Manages SNS canisters and dapp registrations for the ICLighthouse DAO governance system
subcategory_descriptions.SNS Governance: Handles proposals, voting, and neuron management for ICLighthouse DAO
subcategory_descriptions.ICL Ledger: ICRC-1 token ledger for ICL governance token transactions
subcategory_descriptions.Index Canister: Indexes ICL token transactions for efficient account history queries
subcategory_descriptions.SNS Swap: Manages token swap sale for ICLighthouse DAO decentralization launch
subcategory_descriptions.ICL Archive: Stores historical ICL token ledger blocks and transaction records
subcategory_descriptions.ICDex Router: Factory that creates trading pairs and manages automated market makers (OAMM)
subcategory_descriptions.ICDex Validator: Validates trading operations and manages DEX pair configurations across the platform
subcategory_descriptions.DEX Aggregator: Aggregates DEX pairs from multiple sources and manages marketplace listings with NFT staking
subcategory_descriptions.Liquidity Mining: Distributes trading and liquidity mining rewards with NFT-based acceleration
subcategory_descriptions.Trader Canister: Manages trader accounts, order execution, and liquidity positions across DEX pairs
subcategory_descriptions.Asset Canister: Frontend hosting for ICLighthouse trading interface

subcategory_descriptions.Ledger Index: Indexes and stores transaction history from ICRC-1 token ledgers for efficient account lookups

subcategory_descriptions.Logger: Simple log storage canister with append, view, and statistics capabilities.
subcategory_descriptions.Token Wrapper: Token management canister with mint, burn, and transfer capabilities.
subcategory_descriptions.DKIM Oracle: DKIM signing and revocation service for email verification.
subcategory_descriptions.Minting Manager: Manages neuron-based token minting process with fee calculation.
subcategory_descriptions.Rewards Distributor: Distributes neuron staking rewards to token holders based on snapshots.
subcategory_descriptions.Bitcoin Runes Orchestrator: Orchestrates Bitcoin transactions involving Runes tokens.
subcategory_descriptions.ckBTC Minter: Standard ckBTC minter for converting between BTC and ckBTC.

subcategory_descriptions.DeFi Pylon: Hosts automated DeFi vectors (DCA, liquidity, exchange) with built-in DEX swap functionality.
subcategory_descriptions.NTC Relay: Processes NTC (wrapped cycles) minting and canister top-up relay.
subcategory_descriptions.DeFi Aggregator: Price oracle aggregating token and pair data from DEXes.
subcategory_descriptions.NTN Archive: ICRC-3 archive storing NTN token transaction history.
subcategory_descriptions.DeVeFi Root: Factory that creates and manages DeFi Vector trading pairs.
subcategory_descriptions.Neuron Pylon: Hosts ICP/SNS neuron staking automation and NTC minting vectors.
subcategory_descriptions.Ledger Deployer: Factory for deploying and upgrading ICRC-1 token ledgers.
subcategory_descriptions.Liquid Staking: Manages neuron balance and mint ratio for liquid staking token.
subcategory_descriptions.Asset Canister: Frontend hosting for ICPCoins and related UIs.

subcategory_descriptions.Hub: Central routing hub managing cross-chain tickets, tokens, chains, and Runes protocol integration.
subcategory_descriptions.Bitcoin Runes Chain: Bitcoin chain handler for Runes token transactions, etching, and cross-chain bridging.
subcategory_descriptions.ICP Route: Manages ICRC token ledgers and ICP-based cross-chain routing.
subcategory_descriptions.ICP Customs: Handles ckBTC and ICP chain-key token bridging between ICP and other chains.
subcategory_descriptions.EVM Chain: Bridges tokens between ICP and EVM-compatible chains using threshold ECDSA.
subcategory_descriptions.Dogecoin Chain: Dogecoin chain handler for DOGE-based cross-chain token bridging.
subcategory_descriptions.Runes Indexer: Queries Bitcoin Runes balances and metadata from on-chain data.
subcategory_descriptions.Transaction Orchestrator: Orchestrates PSBT signing, transaction broadcasting, and multi-pool coordination.
subcategory_descriptions.DEX/AMM: Decentralized exchange with automated market maker for token swaps and liquidity pools.

subcategory_descriptions.DEX: Main decentralized exchange for token swaps, liquidity pools, and DeFi operations.
subcategory_descriptions.LBP Factory: Creates and manages Liquidity Bootstrapping Pools for fair token launches.
subcategory_descriptions.Airdrop Manager: Handles token airdrops and vesting schedules with time-locked releases.
subcategory_descriptions.Status Monitor: Simple liveness checking canister for system health monitoring.
subcategory_descriptions.SNS Root: Manages SNS canisters and dapp registrations for decentralized governance.
subcategory_descriptions.SNS Governance: Handles proposals, voting, and neuron management for SNS.
subcategory_descriptions.SNS Token Ledger: ICRC-1/2/3 compliant ledger for SNS governance token transactions.
subcategory_descriptions.SNS Swap: Manages token swap sales during SNS decentralization launch.
subcategory_descriptions.SNS Index: Indexes token transactions for efficient account history queries.
subcategory_descriptions.SNS Archive: Stores historical ledger blocks for long-term transaction records.
subcategory_descriptions.Asset Canister: Frontend hosting for web interfaces and static assets.
